verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, and an official CLI, so an agent can query billing objects such as subscriptions and invoices directly. However, the evidence never shows agent-queryable MRR, delinquency, or renewal metrics. Subscription analytics and recovery analytics are documented only as Dashboard monitoring views, so computed metrics would likely need custom aggregation over raw API data. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server or API exposes MRR or analytics metrics, documented queries for delinquent accounts and upcoming renewals, details of the MCP tool coverage for invoices and subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent billing queries.
